description: This Java source file defines a REST API endpoint for managing tenants within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles HTTP routes for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tenants, interfacing with the backend through event bus messages. The class extends an abstract HTTP endpoint and utilizes Vert.x web routing components, incorporating CORS handling, payload processing, and tenant-specific URL path management.

classes.name: TenantManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A REST API endpoint enabling management of tenant data, translating HTTP requests into event bus messages and handling responses accordingly. Implements route setup and operational logic for tenant lifecycle operations.

methods.name: createTenant
methods.description: Handles tenant creation requests, constructs appropriate event bus message, and processes the response to confirm creation.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Handles tenant retrieval by tenant ID, sending an event bus message and processing the reply to deliver tenant info.

methods.name: updateTenant
methods.description: Processes tenant update requests, sets resource version headers, and interacts with event bus.

methods.name: deleteTenant
methods.description: Handles tenant deletion requests by sending delete commands and processing outcomes.

methods.name: doTenantHttpRequest
methods.description: A helper method for constructing and dispatching event bus messages for tenant operations, managing response validation.

methods.name: updatePayloadWithTenantId
methods.description: Ensures the tenant ID from routing context is embedded into the JSON payload, validates non-empty tenant IDs.

methods.name: getTenantIdFromContext
methods.description: Extracts tenant ID from URL parameters or payload JSON to identify the tenant for operations.
